messageboxes.no_source_msg: Please insert a VCD or DVD, or browse to a disc folder first.
messageboxes.no_files_msg:
No valid video files (.DAT) or DVD titles were found.
Make sure you selected the root of a VCD or DVD disc/folder.
messageboxes.ffmpeg_req_msg:
FFmpeg is required for audio extraction, DVD ripping, and video conversion.

Download from https://ffmpeg.org/download.html and ensure
ffmpeg.exe is in your PATH or in a 'ffmpeg/bin' folder next to this script.

Tip: Select 'DAT' video format on VCDs to extract raw files without FFmpeg.
messageboxes.no_sel_msg: No videos selected. Rip all videos?
messageboxes.no_sel_chaps_msg: No chapters selected. Rip all chapters?
messageboxes.eject_msg:
Successfully ripped {success} file(s)!

Would you like to eject the disc now?
messageboxes.err_msg:
Ripped {success} file(s) successfully.
{errors} file(s) had errors — check the console log.
messageboxes.no_drive_msg: No optical disc drive was detected.
messageboxes.unsupported_disc_msg: The detected optical disc is not a valid VCD or DVD-Video (e.g., Audio CD or Blu-ray). Disc Ripper Pro supports VCD and standard DVD-Video optical discs.
messageboxes.timeout_msg: Ripping was stopped due to severely damaged disc sectors or read timeout. Partial video has been saved.
messageboxes.dvd_encrypted_msg: This DVD disc appears to be encrypted or copy-protected (CSS). Disc Ripper Pro does not bypass copy protection. Only unencrypted DVD-Video discs are supported.
messageboxes.eject_busy_msg: Ripping is currently in progress. Are you sure you want to stop ripping and eject the disc?
